What do you think they will do with it? Tap one idea.

Good thinking. This lesson brings it all together: you already know the words, questions and replies for real situations at home, at a clinic and at work. Now you will see them used.

Listen to a real situation

The air conditioner in Mariam's flat is not working. She phones the building office.

MariamHello. The AC in Flat 4 isn’t working. Could I book a repair appointment?
HanaWe can come on Tuesday at ten or three.
MariamI’m only free after two. Could you come at three?
HanaYes, Tuesday at three.
MariamCould you say the time again, please?
HanaTuesday at three in the afternoon.
MariamThank you. If the time changes, I’ll call you.
